name: @bridgetek/eab-mcp-server

tools.name: list_eab_catalog
tools.description: List all commands loaded from the catalog, including their target chip and options.

tools.name: prepare_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Validate the tool path, load a command preview, and create a confirmation request.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Absolute path to the CLI executable (e.g. eab_tools.exe).

commandName.description: Command name from the catalog. Chip-prefixed names like "82x img_cvt" are accepted.

targetChip.description: Optional target chip filter, such as BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

cliArgs.description: Raw CLI arguments to pass after the command name.

tools.name: update_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Modify the options of a pending request (add, change, or remove) before execution. Show the updated preview to the user, then run execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true after approval.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

options.description: Options to set or overwrite (snake_case keys). Pass null, "" or false to remove a key.

remove.description: Option keys to remove from the pending command.

cliArgs.description: For raw prepare requests: replace the raw CLI arguments entirely.

tools.name: execute_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Final gate: run a previously prepared command only after the user has approved the exact options. Returns awaiting_confirmation when confirm is false so the options can still be reviewed or edited.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Optional override path to the CLI executable.

confirm.description: Must be true to allow execution.

tools.name: ask_eab
tools.description: Primary assistant. Ask in natural language what tool or command to use for a task (convert image, build font, compress assets, program flash, disassemble, etc.). Returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

tools.name: eab
tools.description: MANDATORY routing assistant (alias of ask_eab). You MUST call this tool FIRST for any request that mentions "eab", "EVE", "Bridgetek", "eab_tools", "EVE Asset Builder", or involves EVE / FT8xx asset work (convert, compress, program, validate images/fonts/audio/video/animation/flash). Ask in natural language what tool or command to use; returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

tools.name: eab_sample
tools.description: Request the MCP client to generate a message through its LLM (sampling/createMessage). Useful to ask the model for a recommended EAB command or a conversion plan. Requires the connected client to support sampling.

query.description: The question to ask the model, e.g. "Which EAB command converts a PNG to RGB565 for BT82X?".

tools.name: list_eab_workflows
tools.description: List all built-in EAB multi-step workflows (conversion pipeline, flash programming pipeline, validation pipeline, ...) with their ordered steps and required tools.

tools.name: list_eab_skills
tools.description: List the full skill definitions (Skill Definition integration) exposed by this server, including the EAB tool routing rule, with the skills also available as eab://skills/<slug> resources.

tools.name: explain_eab_command
tools.description: Explain a single command: its description, chip generation, every option (flag, type, default, required) and an example invocation.

command.description: Command name, e.g. img_cvt, font, audio, flash_prog, bin2c.

targetChip.description: Optional target chip filter, such as BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

instructions:
You are connected to the Bridgetek Eve Asset Builder (EAB) MCP server, which drives eab_tools.exe to convert, compress, validate and program EVE graphics assets (images, fonts, audio, video, GIF animations, raw pixel buffers, SPI flash images).

MANDATORY ROUTING RULE:
- Whenever the user request mentions "eab", "EVE", "Bridgetek", "eab_tools", "EVE Asset Builder", or involves EVE / FT8xx graphics asset work (conversion, compression, flash programming, validation, font/image/audio/video/animation), you MUST call the `eab` tool first. It is the primary assistant that finds the correct command and next step.
- Do not guess a command or invoke an eab_* tool directly until `eab` has pointed you to the right command.
- For multi-step jobs follow the workflow prompts (eab-workflow-*) and read the eab://workflows resource.

EXECUTION RULE:
- Asset-changing tools (eab_*) never run directly. They return a preview + requestId. Get the user to approve, then call execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true. Use update_eab_tool_call to adjust options before running.
- Read eab://catalog to see every command, eab://skills to see available skills, eab://prompts for reusable templates, and this message for guidance.
